digest.component_or_area: plan-review Pass-1 finder; model selection and escalation
propositions: Pass-1 (the finder that generates blocking findings) silently downgraded from opus to haiku after b690 landed, because plan-review.yaml declares model_ladder rung 0 as 'trivial' but req.config was previously discarded, making the declaration ineffective until b690 honored it

The regression is invisible in artifacts (only verifier model is recorded in sidecar) and gate failures are silent (haiku Pass-1 yields fewer findings but surfaces as PASS, getting signed and proceeding)
Archaeology of 3,843 plan-review sidecars shows 115 opus runs before 2026-06-27 and zero after, confirming Pass-1 ran on opus before _verifier_cfg landed and haiku takeover began
Prerequisite finder bin packing now sizes to haiku's 200k window instead of sonnet/opus's 1M, causing context-limit escalation to fire where it previously could not
model_ladder rung 0 must be changed from 'trivial' to 'frontier' to restore Pass-1 to opus, as it ran before the unintended regression
Without b690, no ladder rung influenced Pass-1 at all; b690 is the enabler that makes the declaration reachable, exposing the wrong rung value
